review.why: Writes operations, supply chain, manufacturing, maintenance, retail and hospitality resumes without inventing savings or site-wide credit.
review.summary: Clarifies industry, level, facilities, shifts and systems, then gives evidence prompts per setting. It keeps output, productivity and utilization distinct with their denominator and period, pairs productivity with quality or safety, separates cost avoidance from realized savings, records licenses and trade qualifications exactly and keeps safety figures scoped and sourced.
strengths: Never multiplies a short trial into an annual saving without a confirmed estimate
Course completion is not treated as professional certification
Worked example with the claim to avoid
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Narrow audience: operations and trade roles
Does not assume ERP or supervisory expertise
